prompt: Volunteer sign-up for our riverbank cleanup on a light theme. Fields: Full name (required), Email (required), Mobile number (phone), Availability as radio buttons (Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, Either), T-shirt size dropdown (S, M, L, XL, XXL), and a required checkbox 'I agree to the safety briefing'. Button says 'Count me in' and afterwards show 'Thanks! We'll email you a meeting point the week before.'

Bug report form, dark theme. Summary (required, at most 80 characters), Steps to reproduce (long text, required, at least 30 characters), Severity dropdown (Low, Medium, High, Critical; required), App version (text, placeholder '2.4.1', must look like three dot-separated numbers), and an optional email if they want a reply. Button: 'File bug'.

Job application for a warehouse supervisor role. Name (required), Email (required), Phone (required), LinkedIn profile (a URL), Years of experience (number from 0 to 50, required), Preferred shift radio (Day, Evening, Night), and a cover note of no more than 1500 characters. Submit reads 'Apply' and should send them to https://careers.northwind.example/applied afterwards.

Clinic appointment request: Patient name (required), Date of birth (date, required), Preferred appointment date (date, required), Reason for visit dropdown (Check-up, Vaccination, Follow-up, Other), and Anything else we should know (long text). Submit 'Request appointment', then show 'We'll call within one business day to confirm.'

Short tools survey for our remote team: Your name, and 'Which of these do you use every week?' where people can tick all that apply from Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet and Discord. Then a comments box. Button 'Send answers'.

Donation pledge form for the food bank. Amount in dollars (required, minimum 5, maximum 10000, placeholder '50', help text 'Whole dollars only'), Frequency radio (One-time, Monthly), Name, Email (required), and an optional dedication message up to 200 characters. Button 'Pledge'. Light theme.

Our CRM expects the submission keys first_name, last_name, email_address and postal_code. Build a lead form whose visible labels are 'First name', 'Last name', 'Work email' and 'ZIP code', all required, mapped to those keys. ZIP must be exactly 5 digits. Button 'Get the brochure'.

Change-of-address form for library members: Library card number (required, exactly 14 digits), Street address (required), City (required), State dropdown (Oregon, Washington, Idaho, California), ZIP (required, 5 digits), and Effective date (date). Submit 'Update my address'.

Open-house registration: Parent name (required), Email (required), Number attending (1 to 6), Grade of interest dropdown (Kindergarten, Grade 1, Grade 2, Grade 3). Submit 'Reserve seats'. Tag the form with the campaign 'spring-open-house-2026' so we can filter submissions later.

End-of-course evaluation, dark theme, titled 'Intro to Pottery — how did we do?'. Three required ratings from 1 to 5 as radio buttons: Instructor clarity, Pace of the class, Studio facilities. Then 'What should we change?' as long text. Button 'Submit evaluation'.
Just one required mobile number field and a button that says 'Text me the link'. Dark theme, no title.

Artist residency portfolio submission: Name (required), Email (required), Portfolio website (URL, required), Instagram profile (URL, optional), Primary medium dropdown (Painting, Sculpture, Photography, Textile, Digital), Artist statement (required, between 100 and 1000 characters). Submit 'Send portfolio'.

Equipment checkout form. Employee ID (required) must be two capital letters followed by four digits, like AB1234 — say that in the help text. Item dropdown (Laptop, Projector, Camera, Tripod), Checkout date and Return date (both dates, required), Signature name (required). Submit 'Check out'.

Booking form for the 2026 summer camp. Camper name (required), Guardian email (required), Camper age (number, 8 to 14, required), Arrival date (date, required, no earlier than June 15 2026 and no later than August 10 2026), Allergies (long text). Submit 'Book my spot'.

Testimonial collection form: Name (required), Company, Role, and the testimonial itself as long text, required, capped at 280 characters, with placeholder 'What changed for you after using our service?'. Also a required checkbox 'You may publish this on our website'. Button 'Share'.

Webinar registration titled 'Spreadsheets for Small Business'. First name (required), Email (required), Business size radio (Just me, 2–10, 11–50, 50+). Submit button 'Save my seat'; after submitting, redirect to /webinar/confirmed.

Pet adoption inquiry, light theme. Your name (required), Phone (required, placeholder '(555) 123-4567'), Which pet are you interested in? (text, placeholder 'e.g. Biscuit, the beagle mix'), Do you have a fenced yard? (radio: Yes, No), Other pets at home (number, 0 to 10, help 'Count dogs and cats only'). Button 'Send inquiry'.
Add a required Company size dropdown right after Work email with options 1–10, 11–50, 51–200 and 201+, and switch the form to the dark theme.
